objective: Independently receive identity, reply-question history, bounded note replacement and exact accepted-origin binding through the actual native model/file API.

cases.expected: Two visits share venue identity/name/date but occupy different accepted-week occurrences. Notes/replies from one never attach to the other after a real companion JSON write/read and explicit replacement.

Record a literal Unicode/whitespace reply to the first visit's original questions, then revise its current questions. A companion roundtrip retains the reply and the exact original replyQuestions separately from the later current questions.

Before import retain an off-week note and a current-week note omitted from the companion. Both stay exactly unchanged; supplied occurrence records are replaced only within the existing declared accepted-origin/date binding.

Change only the accepted original request identity or only the accepted trace identity while keeping visible week/venue/date values the same. Refuse the earlier companion before any current note changes, including the other occurrence and unrelated retained notes.

execution: One independently authored native model/file receiving fixture with actual JSON roundtrip, exact input/output hashes and before/after state. No provider/browser operations, no core/source edits, no broad repeated suite. Original behavior is only claimed if the actual original API supports the same invoked path.
limits: The producer owns UI/Worker/stale-read and broad browser qualification. This receiver does not infer cross-version or current-source equivalence without primary blob checks.
